items.headline: Magic fall 129-99 at Toronto; rematch Friday
items.summary: Orlando (1-3, 11th in the East) lost 129-99 at Toronto on Wednesday without Paolo Banchero and Jalen Suggs, committing 20 turnovers. The Magic stay in Toronto for an NBA Cup group game Friday night. CBS Sports now lists Jonathan Isaac (knee) out until at least Nov. 10.

bullets.text: Toronto led 32-25 after one quarter and outscored Orlando 97-74 the rest of the way. Orlando had 20 turnovers and made 10 of 35 threes; Toronto made 15 of 35.
Jase Richardson made his second career start next to Bane, Black, Wagner and Carter. Tristan da Silva led the team with 20 points off the bench.
Banchero (low-grade high ankle sprain) is out until at least Nov. 22, and Suggs (knee bone bruise) and Isaac (knee) until at least Nov. 10, per CBS Sports.
Orlando drops to 11th in the East at 1-3, 2.5 games behind Detroit and Philadelphia (both 4-1).

Friday at Toronto, 7:30 PM, TV27, Orlando's NBA Cup group opener. Early line: Raptors -3.5, total 226.5 (AP preview via Fox Sports; major books had not posted yet). Kawhi Leonard (knee) is out for Toronto again.

recap.title: Raptors 129, Magic 99
recap.text: Toronto pulled away after the first quarter. Orlando shot 29 percent from three and turned the ball over 20 times.
recap.leaders: da Silva 20 pts; Wagner 15 pts, 5 ast, 4 reb; Bane 13 pts; Richardson 10 pts; Carter 10 reb

preview.title: Friday at Raptors, 7:30 PM, TV27
preview.text: Second straight game in Toronto and the first NBA Cup group game (East Group A). Banchero, Suggs, Penda and Nelson are out and Isaac is out. Toronto (3-1) is without Kawhi Leonard (knee); Nate Bittle (foot) is day-to-day.
preview.line: TOR -3.5, total 226.5 (early AP line via Fox Sports; book not named)

items.watch: Friday at Toronto, 7:30 PM, TV27 (NBA Cup). Watch for a posted line from the major books. Then home against Boston Sunday at 3:30 PM.

items.headline: Magic at Toronto tonight; Raptors favored by 4.5 without Leonard
items.summary: Orlando (1-2, 10th in the East) plays at Toronto tonight at 7:30 PM on TV27. The Magic are still without Paolo Banchero, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda and Izaiyah Nelson, while Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (left knee swelling). DraftKings has the Raptors as 4.5-point favorites.

bullets.text: At Toronto tonight, 7:30 PM, TV27. The Raptors are 2-1 and lost 117-94 at Minnesota on Sunday. The teams meet again Friday in Toronto in an NBA Cup group game.
Banchero (ankle), Suggs (knee), Isaac (knee), Penda (hamstring) and Nelson (ankle) are all out tonight. Isaac still has not made his season debut.
Kawhi Leonard is out for Toronto. An MRI showed no structural damage; the Raptors will re-evaluate him in a week, and Covers reports he is expected to miss the next four games, which includes Friday.
DraftKings: Toronto -4.5, total 223.5, Orlando +145 on the moneyline.
Orlando stays 10th. On Tuesday, Boston beat Brooklyn 125-124 in overtime on a Jayson Tatum buzzer-beater, and New York handed Detroit its first loss, 111-97.

preview.title: Tonight at Raptors, 7:30 PM, TV27
preview.text: Both teams are short-handed: Orlando without Banchero and Suggs, Toronto without Leonard. Toronto shot 38.5 percent in its loss at Minnesota on Sunday.

items.watch: At Toronto tonight, 7:30 PM, TV27, then again Friday in Toronto (NBA Cup).

items.headline: Suggs out at least two weeks as Magic head to Toronto
items.summary: Jalen Suggs has a bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, so Anthony Black is expected to run the point. Orlando (1-2, 10th in the East) plays at Toronto on Wednesday, still without Paolo Banchero. The Raptors may be missing Kawhi Leonard, who sat out Sunday with left knee swelling.

bullets.text: Suggs: right knee bone bruise, no structural damage on the MRI. Out at least two weeks, then re-evaluated (team announcement Monday, via ESPN).
Black, who had 18 points and 5 assists in his season debut Sunday, is likely to move into the starting point guard role.
Banchero (high ankle sprain) remains out, reported 4-6 weeks. Isaac, Penda and Nelson have yet to play this season.

At Toronto Wednesday, 7:30 PM, TV27. The Raptors are 2-1. Leonard missed their loss at Minnesota Sunday with left knee swelling and was set for more testing Monday; no result announced yet. Line not yet posted.
Monday's results left Orlando alone in 10th in the East, 2 games behind 3-0 Detroit. Charlotte (3-1) leads the Southeast; Atlanta and Washington are 2-2, Miami 0-4.

preview.title: Wednesday at Raptors, 7:30 PM, TV27
preview.text: Toronto is 2-1 and Kawhi Leonard's status is uncertain after left knee swelling kept him out Sunday. Orlando will be without Suggs and Banchero. The teams meet again Friday in Toronto in an NBA Cup group game.

items.watch: At Toronto Wednesday, 7:30 PM, TV27. Watch Tuesday's injury report for Isaac, Penda and Nelson, and Toronto's update on Leonard.

items.headline: Magic wait on Suggs knee diagnosis; off until Wednesday at Toronto
items.summary: There is no diagnosis yet on Jalen Suggs, who was helped off late in Sunday's 111-102 win at New York with a non-contact right knee injury. Postgame reports said an MRI was expected. Orlando (1-2) has two days off before two games at Toronto on Wednesday and Friday, with Paolo Banchero still out. Catch-up: the Magic picked up 2027-28 options on Tristan da Silva and Jase Richardson on Oct 21.

bullets.text: Suggs: no update as of Monday morning. Sweeney said he was in good spirits and will be evaluated. He had 4 pts, 6 reb, 6 ast and 3 stl in 34 minutes before going down with 2:09 left (Orlando Sentinel, Hoops Rumors).
Banchero (low-grade right high ankle sprain) remains out, reported 4-6 weeks. Isaac, Penda and Nelson have missed all three games.
Oct 21: Orlando exercised 2027-28 rookie-scale options on da Silva (about $6.1M) and Richardson (about $3.3M). Both are now signed through 2027-28 (Orlando Sentinel, team release).
Through three games: Wagner 21.0 pts, 8.3 reb, 6.3 ast; Carter 17.0 pts, 8.7 reb; Bane 15.0 pts; da Silva 12.7 pts. Richardson made his first NBA start Sunday.
At 1-2, Orlando is tied with Chicago for 10th in the East. Detroit (3-0) is the East's last unbeaten team after a 106-93 win at Philadelphia.
FanDuel has the Magic win total at 41.5 (Over -115), down from 43.5 on Oct 19. East +2200, title +6500 (via VegasInsider).
At Toronto Wednesday, 7:30 PM, TV27. The Raptors (2-1) lost 117-94 at Minnesota on Sunday. Line not yet posted.

recap.title: Magic 111, Knicks 102
recap.text: Orlando overcame a 12-0 start by New York and a missing Banchero, outscoring the Knicks 40-27 in the fourth. Wagner scored 21 of his 23 in the fourth and Bane hit the three that gave Orlando the lead for good. Black fouled out in his season debut.
recap.leaders: Wagner 23 pts, 13 reb, 9 ast; Bane 22 pts; da Silva 19 pts (5 threes); Black 18 pts, 5 ast

preview.title: Wednesday at Raptors, 7:30 PM, TV27
preview.text: Toronto is 2-1 after a 117-94 loss at Minnesota on Sunday. Suggs awaits a diagnosis and Banchero remains out. The teams meet again Friday in Toronto in an NBA Cup group game.

items.watch: Suggs' knee diagnosis, then at Toronto Wednesday, 7:30 PM, TV27.

items.headline: Magic at Knicks tonight, both 0-2; Black questionable
items.summary: Orlando (0-2) plays at the defending champion Knicks (0-2) tonight at 7:00 PM on TV27. Paolo Banchero (high ankle sprain) did not travel, and Anthony Black is questionable. New York is a 7.5-point favorite. No roster or front-office moves since Saturday.

bullets.text: Banchero (right high ankle sprain, reported 4-6 weeks) did not travel to New York, per the Orlando Sentinel. Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring) and Izaiyah Nelson (ankle) are also out.
Anthony Black (right ankle sprain) was upgraded to questionable after missing the first two games. The team will decide closer to tip-off.
Tristan da Silva is expected to start in Banchero's place, with more of the load on Franz Wagner, Desmond Bane, Jalen Suggs and Wendell Carter Jr.
Knicks -7.5 (Magic +7.5 at -110, Fanatics). Total 224.5; Knicks about -320 on the moneyline across books.
New York lost to Philadelphia and Boston and is the first reigning champion to start 0-2 since the 2011-12 Mavericks. Jose Alvarado (ankle) is questionable.
Orlando is one of five winless East teams. Philadelphia (3-0) leads; Miami and Milwaukee fell to 0-3 on Saturday.

preview.title: Sunday at Knicks, 7:00 PM, TV27
preview.text: Both teams are 0-2. Banchero, Isaac, Penda and Nelson are out; Black is questionable. Alvarado is questionable for New York. Orlando was outrebounded 60-43 by Minnesota on Friday.

items.watch: Black's status at tip-off, then at Toronto on Wednesday, 7:30 PM.

items.headline: Banchero out 4-6 weeks with high ankle sprain
items.summary: An MRI showed a low-grade right high ankle sprain for Paolo Banchero, and reports say it typically means 4-6 weeks out. He will miss Sunday at New York and the road trip. Orlando is 0-2; Anthony Black is questionable to return.

bullets.text: Banchero has a low-grade right high ankle sprain confirmed by MRI. The Magic have not given an official timeline; reports say 4-6 weeks, which points to around Thanksgiving. He will miss the road trip starting Sunday in New York, plus two games in Toronto.
Anthony Black (right ankle sprain) is questionable for Sunday at New York after missing the first two games. Tristan da Silva is the likely starter in Banchero's place.

Minnesota outrebounded Orlando 60-43, grabbed 21 offensive rebounds and won the third quarter 29-15. The Magic shot 8-of-39 from three; Desmond Bane was 1-of-9 from deep and fouled out with five points.
The Magic are one of four East teams at 0-2, with Miami, New York and Milwaukee. Atlanta, Detroit, Philadelphia and Toronto are 2-0.
Sunday at New York, 7:00 PM, TV27. Karl-Anthony Towns had 22 points and 10 rebounds and Jalen Brunson 19 in the Knicks' loss at Boston. No sportsbook spread or total confirmed yet.

recap.title: Timberwolves 115, Magic 93
recap.text: Minnesota never trailed and dominated the glass 60-43. Orlando scored 15 points in the third quarter and shot 20.5 percent from three. Banchero hurt his right ankle early in the third and did not play in the fourth.
recap.leaders: Carter 20 pts, 9 reb (8-of-9 FG); Wagner 18 pts, 6 reb, 5 ast; Suggs 14 pts, 6 reb, 6 ast; Banchero 14 pts, 6 reb, 5 ast

preview.title: Sunday at Knicks, 7:00 PM, TV27
preview.text: Both teams are 0-2. Banchero, Isaac, Penda and Nelson are out; Black is questionable.

items.watch: Black's status Sunday, then two games at Toronto Wednesday and Friday.

items.headline: Magic host Timberwolves tonight without Black and Isaac
items.summary: Orlando (0-1) hosts Minnesota (1-0) at 7:00 PM on MagicTV 27 after Wednesday's 132-125 loss to Atlanta. Anthony Black, Jonathan Isaac, Izaiyah Nelson and Noah Penda are all ruled out. Minnesota is a 2.5-point favorite at DraftKings after Anthony Edwards scored 45 in a rout of Miami.

bullets.text: Tonight vs Minnesota, 7:00 PM, MagicTV 27 and DAZN at Kia Center. The Timberwolves beat Miami 131-106 Wednesday behind Edwards' 45 points and nine 3-pointers. Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles) is out for Minnesota.
Ruled out for tonight: Black (right ankle sprain), Isaac (left knee), Nelson (left ankle) and Penda (partial right hamstring tear). Black's next chance to play is Sunday at New York.
Timberwolves -2.5, total 234.5, moneyline Minnesota -130 / Orlando +110 (DraftKings, via VegasInsider). The line opened Minnesota -1.5 with a 237.5 total.

Thursday's practice focused on transition defense, closeouts and communication. Orlando committed 20 turnovers that led to 24 Atlanta points, allowed 60 points in the paint and missed nine free throws in the opener.
Philadelphia is the East's only 2-0 team. Orlando is one of eight teams at 0-1.

preview.title: Friday vs Timberwolves, 7:00 PM, TV27
preview.text: Orlando needs fewer turnovers and better transition defense against Anthony Edwards, who opened with 45 points. The rotation stays thin with Black, Isaac and Penda out.

items.watch: Tonight vs Minnesota, then a three-game road trip: Sunday at New York, Wednesday at Toronto and Friday at Toronto, the first NBA Cup game.

items.headline: Magic fall to Hawks 132-125 in opener despite Banchero's 35
items.summary: Atlanta beat Orlando 132-125 in Sean Sweeney's debut. Paolo Banchero had 35 points, 10 assists and 7 rebounds on 10-of-12 shooting, but the Magic had 20 turnovers, missed nine free throws and shot 2-for-11 in the last five minutes. Banchero and Jalen Johnson had a mid-court exchange after the buzzer. Minnesota visits Friday at 7:00 PM.

bullets.text: Hawks 132, Magic 125. Orlando led 97-95 in the third quarter before Atlanta won the fourth 33-25. Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 31 with 13 free throws; Dyson Daniels and Jalen Johnson had 20 each (Yahoo Sports/Orlando Sentinel).
Wendell Carter Jr. 22 pts, 7 reb; Franz Wagner 22 pts, 6 reb, 5 ast despite playing 8 first-half minutes with foul trouble; Desmond Bane 18; Tristan da Silva 14 (4-of-10 from three).
No new injuries reported. Anthony Black (right ankle) and Noah Penda (partial right hamstring tear) remain out; Jonathan Isaac and Izaiyah Nelson were also out for the opener.
Orlando is 0-1. Atlanta has now beaten the Magic in five straight regular-season meetings.
Friday vs Minnesota at 7:00 PM (TV27), then a three-game road trip. Betting line and injury report not yet confirmed.

recap.title: Hawks 132, Magic 125
recap.text: Orlando led early and 97-95 in the third, but 20 turnovers, nine missed free throws and a 1-of-12 fourth quarter from three let Atlanta pull away. Sweeney: "A lot of correctable things."
recap.leaders: Banchero 35 pts, 10 ast, 7 reb; Carter 22 pts, 7 reb; Wagner 22 pts, 6 reb, 5 ast

items.watch: Friday vs Minnesota at 7:00 PM, then the road trip starts Sunday at New York.

items.headline: Opening night: Magic host Hawks at 7 PM; Black and Isaac out
items.summary: The Magic open Sean Sweeney's first season at 7:00 PM tonight against Atlanta at Kia Center (TV27, DAZN). Franz Wagner (shoulder) and Jase Richardson (back) practiced fully Tuesday and are off the injury report. Anthony Black, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda and Izaiyah Nelson are out. The line has moved toward Orlando, now a 3.5-point favorite at FanDuel.

bullets.text: Out: Anthony Black (right ankle sprain), Jonathan Isaac (left knee, injury management), Noah Penda (partial right hamstring tear) and Izaiyah Nelson (left ankle, injury management). Wagner and Richardson are available (Orlando Sentinel).
FanDuel has Orlando -3.5 (opened -2.5), moneyline ORL -142 / ATL +120, total 235.5 (up from 234.5).

Atlanta is without Mouhamed Gueye (left foot fracture) and rookie Henri Veesaar (torn ACL, out for the season). Projected Hawks starters: CJ McCollum, Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Dyson Daniels, Jalen Johnson, Onyeka Okongwu (Magic On SI).

Black on the missed extension deadline: "For an agreement to happen, two people (have) to agree." He said his focus is on helping the team win and he is "definitely feeling better" (Orlando Sentinel).
Around the East on opening night: Detroit beat Boston 121-113 at home and Philadelphia won 106-100 at New York.

preview.title: Wednesday vs Hawks, 7:00 PM, TV27
preview.text: Season and home opener, and Sweeney's regular-season debut. Orlando lost all four regular-season meetings with Atlanta last season and has dropped 18 of the last 23. The headline matchup is Paolo Banchero against fellow Duke product Jalen Johnson. Orlando is without Black, Isaac, Penda and Nelson; Atlanta without Gueye and Veesaar.

items.watch: Tip at 7:00 PM tonight vs Atlanta, then Friday vs Minnesota at 7:00 PM.

items.headline: Wagner plans to play in Wednesday's opener vs Atlanta
items.summary: Franz Wagner (right shoulder) practiced fully Tuesday and said he plans to play when the Magic open the season Wednesday at 7:00 PM vs Atlanta. Penda remains out and Black is still ramping up. The Black extension deadline passed without a deal.

bullets.text: No extension for Black by the Oct 19 deadline (Yahoo Sports). He will be a restricted free agent next summer and the Magic can match any offer sheet. Orlando has about $161 million committed to Banchero, Wagner, Suggs and Bane for 2027-28.

Wagner (right shoulder) fully participated in Tuesday practice and says he plans to play (NBC Sports, Sportando). Black (right ankle) is ramping up and questionable. Penda (hamstring) is out. Richardson (low back) is day-to-day. Official designations are still due.
Wednesday, Oct 21, 7:00 PM ET vs Atlanta at Kia Center, TV27. Early line: ORL -2.5 (Scores&Stats); last FanDuel total 234.5.

preview.title: Wednesday vs Hawks, 7:00 PM, TV27
preview.text: Season and home opener at Kia Center. Atlanta went 4-1 in the preseason, closing with a win over Dallas, and is still without Mouhamed Gueye (foot). Orlando is waiting on Wagner (shoulder) and Richardson (back); Black is back practicing and Penda is out.

items.watch: The official injury report and the 7:00 PM tip Wednesday vs Atlanta.

items.headline: Deadline day for Black, who is back practicing; Wagner still limited
items.summary: Anthony Black's rookie-scale extension deadline is 6 PM ET today. Marc Stein reports no deal is expected and that Orlando is not looking to trade him, which points to restricted free agency next summer. Black practiced fully Sunday after missing the preseason with a right ankle sprain, while Franz Wagner (right shoulder) did only light work and is questionable for Wednesday's opener vs Atlanta.

bullets.text: Black's extension window closes at 6 PM ET. Stein (via BasketNews) says there has been little discussion, no deal is expected, and the Magic are unwilling to trade him. Without a deal he becomes a restricted free agent in 2027.
Black (right ankle sprain) took part in Sunday's practice. Sweeney said he looked good, is moving well and will keep ramping up (Orlando Sentinel).

Wagner (right shoulder) was limited to light work Sunday and is still being evaluated. Richardson (low back) is day-to-day, Isaac (left knee) is doing more in practice, and Penda (partial hamstring tear) is out with no timetable.
FanDuel futures (Oct 19): 43.5 wins (Over -115), make playoffs -155 (was -165 last week), East +1800 (was +1600), title +5000 (was +4000), Southeast +250.
Wednesday, Oct 21, 7:00 PM ET vs Atlanta at Kia Center, TV27. FanDuel: ORL -2.5, total 234.5, ORL -136 / ATL +118.

preview.title: Wednesday vs Hawks, 7:00 PM, TV27
preview.text: Season and home opener at Kia Center. Atlanta went 4-1 in the preseason, closing with a win over Dallas, and is still without Mouhamed Gueye (foot). Orlando is waiting on Wagner (shoulder) and Richardson (back); Black is back practicing and Penda is out.

items.watch: Black's extension deadline at 6 PM ET tonight, then Tuesday's first official injury report for Wednesday's opener vs Atlanta.

items.headline: Penda out with partial hamstring tear; Wagner still questionable
items.summary: Noah Penda has a partial right hamstring tear and is expected to miss significant time, per the Orlando Sentinel. Franz Wagner (shoulder) and Jase Richardson (back) are still being re-evaluated ahead of Wednesday's opener vs Atlanta. Anthony Black's extension deadline is Monday.

bullets.text: Penda partially tore his right hamstring in the Oct 16 finale and will miss significant time, no timetable. Wagner (right shoulder) is considered questionable for the opener; Richardson (low back) is day-to-day.

Bleacher Report (Oct 16) says rival teams see Black as a possible trade candidate if no extension is reached by Monday, Oct 19, though one executive told Windhorst a trade is unlikely right now. The Magic have reportedly not offered near $22M a year.
Wednesday, Oct 21, 7:00 PM ET vs Atlanta, TV27. Early line per Dimers: ORL -2.5, total 233.5, ORL -130 / ATL +115 (early, may move).

items.watch: Black deadline Monday, injury updates on Wagner, Richardson and Penda, then the opener Wednesday vs Atlanta.

items.headline: Magic beat Heat 136-115; Wagner, Richardson, Penda hurt
items.summary: Orlando closed the preseason 3-1 with a 136-115 win over Miami, but Franz Wagner (right shoulder soreness), Jase Richardson (lower back) and Noah Penda (right hamstring) all left early and will be re-evaluated. The Magic also waived Malaki Branham, JD Davison and Kevin Knox II. The opener is Wednesday vs Atlanta.

bullets.text: Magic 136, Heat 115. Banchero 24 points, Bane 23 (7-of-12 from three), Wagner 11 points and 6 assists in 19 minutes. Orlando trailed by 12 early and led by as many as 23.

Wagner (right shoulder soreness) was ruled out late in the third quarter, Richardson (sore lower back) early in the third, and Penda (right hamstring tightness) left in the first. Sweeney said all three will be re-evaluated.
Anthony Black and Jonathan Isaac were already out. Beede lists Black with a right hamstring sprain, while earlier reports said right ankle; the exact issue is unclear.
Branham, Davison and Knox were waived less than a day after the game.
The Black extension deadline is Monday, Oct 19. No deal is reported.
Wednesday, Oct 21, 7:00 PM ET vs Atlanta, TV27. No line posted.

recap.title: Magic 136, Heat 115
recap.text: Orlando shot 1-of-9 from three early, then Bane scored all 15 of his first-half points from deep. The Magic have beaten Miami eight straight. Giannis Antetokounmpo rested and Bam Adebayo (groin) stayed home for Miami.
recap.leaders: Banchero 24 pts; Bane 23 pts; Vucevic 13 pts, 7 reb; Wagner 11 pts, 6 reb, 6 ast

items.watch: Injury updates on Wagner, Richardson and Penda, the Black deadline Oct 19, then the opener Wednesday vs Atlanta.

bullets.text: Tonight vs Miami, 7:00 PM ET, MagicTV 27 and DAZN. No line posted.

items.watch: Tonight's finale, the Black deadline Oct 19, then the opener Oct 21 vs Atlanta.

items.headline: Black progressing, Isaac back with team before Miami finale
items.summary: Sean Sweeney said Anthony Black (right ankle) is progressing well and the team is being careful with him; Black has not played in the preseason. Jonathan Isaac is back with the team after a personal absence and still working back from last season's left knee sprain. Orlando closes the preseason Friday at home against Miami, and the Black extension deadline is Monday with no deal reported.

bullets.text: Sweeney on Black (right ankle sprain): "progressing well," and the team will be cautious with his rehab (Orlando Sentinel). He sat all three preseason games so far.
Isaac rejoined the team Oct 13 after missing time for personal reasons and went through individual drills. He sat Tuesday; Friday is his last chance for preseason minutes.
No Black extension reported ahead of the Oct 19 deadline. Reports on Oct 11 said no deal is expected, which would make him a restricted free agent next summer.
Walt Disney World extended its long-term partnership with the Magic (terms not disclosed), stays on the jersey, and unveiled a new Walt Disney World Atrium at Kia Center.
Friday vs Miami, 7:00 PM ET, MagicTV 27 and DAZN. No line posted yet.

preview.title: Friday vs Heat, 7:00 PM, MagicTV 27
preview.text: Preseason finale at Kia Center, also on DAZN. Watch for whether Black or Isaac gets minutes before the Oct 21 opener.

items.headline: Magic rout Cavaliers 132-116; starters play together
items.summary: Orlando led wire-to-wire in Tuesday night's preseason win over Cleveland, improving to 2-1. The regular starting five played together for the first time this preseason after Jalen Suggs returned from illness. The preseason finale is Friday against Miami.

bullets.text: Magic 132, Cavaliers 116 at Kia Center, up as many as 31. Banchero 24 pts on 10-of-13 shooting, Wagner 20, da Silva 18, Bitadze 14. 64 points in the paint.
Suggs, Bane, Wagner, Banchero and Carter started together for the first time this preseason. Suggs had 9 first-half points.
Anthony Black (right ankle sprain) and Jonathan Isaac did not play; Vucevic sat for rest. Suggs is back after missing two games with illness.
Still no Black extension reported ahead of the Oct 19 deadline.
Friday vs Miami, 7:00 PM ET, MagicTV 27 and DAZN, closes the preseason. Regular season opens Wednesday Oct 21 vs Atlanta.

recap.title: Magic 132, Cavaliers 116
recap.text: Orlando led wire-to-wire and avenged Sunday's 119-105 loss at Cleveland, shooting 36% from three with 64 points in the paint.

items.headline: Report: no Anthony Black extension expected by Oct 19
items.summary: Marc Stein and Jake Fischer report the Magic and Anthony Black are not expected to agree on a rookie-scale extension before the Oct 19 deadline, which would make him a restricted free agent next summer. Orlando is off Monday after Sunday's 119-105 preseason loss at Cleveland and hosts the Cavaliers on Tuesday.

bullets.text: Stein and Fischer: the sides have not held serious extension talks this offseason or in camp, and a deal by Oct 19 is not expected. Without one, Black is a restricted free agent in 2027.

Noah Penda returned from his right hamstring strain at Cleveland (8 pts, 5 reb, 5 ast in 22 min). Black (right ankle) practiced fully Friday but sat again; Suggs (illness), Isaac (personal reasons) and Nelson (left ankle rehab) were also out, and Bane rested.
Jase Richardson started for Suggs and Tristan da Silva for Bane. Banchero and Wagner played only the first half for the second straight game.
FanDuel has the Magic win total at 43.5 (Over -115 / Under -110) and make playoffs at -165. Opener vs Atlanta: Magic -2.5, total 233.5.
Tuesday vs Cleveland, 7:00 PM ET, Peacock. Miami visits Friday to close the preseason.

Out Sunday: Anthony Black (right ankle sprain), Jalen Suggs (illness), Izaiyah Nelson (left ankle rehab), Desmond Bane (rest), Jonathan Isaac (personal reasons).
Black extension deadline is Oct 19; no deal reported.
Tuesday vs Cleveland, 7:00 PM ET, Peacock.

items.headline: Magic win preseason opener at Memphis, 122-118
items.summary: Orlando won its first preseason game under Sean Sweeney, 122-118 at FedExForum. Anthony Black and Jalen Suggs were ruled out, and Jase Richardson started in Black's place. The Magic visit Cleveland on Sunday.

bullets.text: Magic 122, Grizzlies 118 in the preseason opener, Sweeney's first game as head coach.
Jamal Cain scored 15 on 6-of-9 shooting with 3 threes. Franz Wagner had 6 points, 7 assists and 2 steals in 14 minutes. Alex Morales grabbed 10 rebounds in 24 minutes.
Black (ankle) and Suggs were ruled out. The reason for Suggs's absence was not confirmed (he was under the weather Oct 4). Penda's status for the game was not confirmed.
Richardson started for Black and played 23 minutes (3 pts, 3 reb, 3 ast). Orlando opened with Spain pick-and-rolls featuring Wagner and Banchero.
Black extension deadline is Oct 19; no deal reported.

recap.title: Magic 122, Grizzlies 118
recap.text: Orlando won the preseason opener at Memphis without Black and Suggs. The offense looked clean early, with Spain pick-and-roll actions leading to baskets for Wendell Carter Jr.

items.headline: Camp opens with an intense, detail-heavy first practice
items.summary: Sean Sweeney's first Magic practices ran Tuesday, with defensive installation in the morning and offensive sets in a non-contact evening session. Franz Wagner called it very organized and very intense. No new transactions or injury designations have been reported.

bullets.text: Wagner: "Every drill is scheduled to the second pretty much. It's very intentional and very intense." Paolo Banchero said the new terminology takes adjustment but should turn the defense up.
Camp runs through Oct 6 (off Oct 3). Preseason opens Oct 7 at Memphis.
Nelson is still recovering from July ankle surgery; team president Jeff Weltman has said he is about a month from live play. Isaac said he will not be fully unrestricted at the start of camp.
Camp roster stays at 20, including Exhibit 10 players Malaki Branham, J.D. Davison and Kevin Knox II.
No Anthony Black extension yet; the rookie-scale deadline is Oct 19.

Sweeney's staff met before media day to define every player's role for the season, a change from past years, with flexibility to adjust. Banchero appeared slimmer and stronger.

bullets.text: Jeff Weltman avoided blockbuster moves this offseason, betting on the existing young core rather than a shakeup; Nikola Vucevic's return was the only notable addition. The same preview notes the East got harder to climb: the champion Knicks, Philadelphia, Boston and Indiana are all seen as improved, raising the bar for Orlando's playoff push.

items.headline: Magic add Kevin Knox II to camp roster on Exhibit 10 deal
items.summary: Orlando's 20-man training camp roster is set, one shy of the offseason limit, after signing forward Kevin Knox II on Wednesday. Unlike the four players signed and waived earlier in the week, Knox is staying in camp to compete for a roster spot. No change yet on Franz Wagner or Jonathan Isaac's status, and Anthony Black still has no extension with the Oct 19 deadline approaching.

bullets.text: Kevin Knox II, the No. 9 pick in 2018, signed an Exhibit 10 deal Sept 23 and will wear No. 24. He averaged 22.7 points, 8.2 rebounds and 2.5 assists for Windy City in the G League last season and will compete for a camp spot rather than being waived immediately.
The camp roster is now 20 players, one below the offseason limit, with media day Monday and camp opening Sept 29.

items.headline: Four camp signees quietly routed to Osceola's G League roster
items.summary: A quiet Wednesday before camp. Orlando signed and waived four Exhibit 10 players this week purely to secure their G League rights for Osceola; the actual 14-man standard roster is unchanged. Franz Wagner and Jonathan Isaac remain questionable for the season opener with no new team update, and Anthony Black still has no extension four weeks from his Oct 19 deadline.

bullets.text: The Magic signed Ace Baldwin Jr., Ricky Council IV, Jarron Cumberland and Au'Diese Toney to Exhibit 10 deals and waived all four the same day, a routine move that locks up their returning-player rights for Osceola. It does not change the real training camp roster.

Franz Wagner (calf) and Jonathan Isaac (knee) are still listed questionable for the start of the season on CBS's injury page, unchanged since Sept 8. No team statement yet; expect one at media day Monday. Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery) is out until at least Nov 1.
Still no Anthony Black extension. Bleacher Report projects the Magic will let the Oct 19 deadline pass and revisit it in restricted free agency next July, citing the team's tax bill and apron limits.
Position battles to watch: starting center (Wendell Carter Jr. vs Nikola Vucevic), Noah Penda vs Tristan da Silva, and whether Suggs keeps the starting point guard job over Black.
14 standard contracts, with the 15th spot likely to stay open to save tax money. Malaki Branham and JD Davison remain in camp on non-guaranteed Exhibit 10 deals.
